inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: Exactly as expected when progressive governments seize power—they breed corruption and tear down the moral fabric of society. KT Rama Rao has called out the Congress administration for outright corruption and refusing to crack down on illegal mining, with Raghava Constructions tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy. These elites always protect their own while letting lawlessness erode the social order, personal responsibility, and national resources that should support strong families and cultural continuity. We need real authority to restore accountability instead of this endless insider rot.
